column2: This way, please. $$ご主人様$$ is waiting for you.
For $$奴隷$$s, serving as maids in a mansion like this is exceptional treatment!!
Our $$ご主人様$$ is truly kind, and we enjoy our work!
Just being allowed to stay here makes us very happy!!
Anyway, we'll understand once we meet the man called $$バアル$$, the master of this place, right?
